questions.stemHtml: A 32-year-old woman comes to the dermatology OPD with lesions on her cheeks that aggravate when exposed to sunlight, as shown in the image below. She has also had fatigue, myalgias, and arthralgias over the past four months. What would be the expected finding on direct immunofluorescence of a skin biopsy of a lesion from this patient?

options.label: A
options.text: Granular continuous deposit of IgG and C3 in the dermo-epidermal junction

options.label: B
options.text: Linear IgG and C3 deposits along the basement membrane zone

options.label: D
options.text: Intercellular IgG and C3 deposits in the epidermis
